prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en utredning". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "investigation".
Scene: An investigator organising photographs, notes and a map on a desk to establish what happened, no graphic material.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "utredning = investigation; picture gathering facts.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Polisen inledde en utredning.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established Swedish vocabulary card layout, described in the prompt; no image supplied to generation.
